entry.title: Application by Mrs Allison Hawking [2026] FWC 2716
entry.content:
Ms Hawking applied for a stop-bullying order claiming her General Manager bullied her by reducing her night shifts, allegedly 'banning' her from picking up extra shifts, and mishandling her complaints after she gave a witness statement about a coworker's injury. Deputy President Bell found there was no ban, no punishment, and no repeated unreasonable behaviour, characterising the hours dispute and workload complaints as ordinary workplace events rather than bullying.

Fair Work Commission, 20 Jul 2026, [2026] FWC 2716
